تجتاحي (form VIII)
# تَجْتَاحِي (tajtāḥī) /tad͡ʒ.taː.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
# تُجْتَاحِي (tujtāḥī) /tud͡ʒ.taː.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
